description: This file implements the TaxClassService interface, providing business logic for managing TaxClass entities in the system. It includes methods for listing, retrieving by code or ID, and deleting TaxClass objects, with dependency injection of a DAO for database operations.

classes.name: TaxClassServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of TaxClassService providing methods to manage TaxClass entities, extending generic entity service, and annotated as a Spring Service.

methods.name: TaxClassServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with the TaxClassDao via dependency injection.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxClass entities associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a TaxClass entity based on its unique code.

methods.name: getByCode (overload)
methods.description: Fetches a TaxClass entity based on its code within a specific merchant store.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a TaxClass entity from the system after retrieving it by ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass entity by its unique identifier.
